Resolves #19562

Related: #14800 (the v13.2 cut; found at the operator's hand check, step 2), #19559 (the torn-out vessel now has the pane's size, which is what put a grid header into a window under 600 px wide), #6419 (the rule's origin).

A grid header's text keeps its own size at every window width. `grid/header/Button.scss` counters `button/Base.scss`'s narrow-window text size under the same `(max-width: 600px)` query, and that counter-rule pointed at the default button label size (`--button-text-font-size`, 1rem = 16 px) instead of the header's own `--grid-header-button-font-size` (13 px in neo-dark, 11 px in neo-light): a pane torn out into a 458 px popup grew its header text from 13 to 16 px while the same pane docked in a 1254 px window did not. The block now re-asserts the header's variable, which is what #6419 asked for in 2025 ("this should not happen for the grid scope") and what the operator wants today (the docked size, everywhere). One variable changes; no theme file moves.

Evidence: L3 (component spec) → L3 required (AC-1); the operator's hand at the merged head is AC-2.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `HeaderFontSizeNarrowWindow.spec`: the header text's computed `font-size` at 1100 px equals the variable, the 500 px arm first proves `matchMedia('(max-width: 600px)')` is true, then the text still equals the wide value — CI |
| AC-2 | Post-merge: the operator's torn-out Workstation grid shows the docked header size — Post-Merge Validation |

## Deltas from ticket
- None. The spec reuses the `apps/grid-focus` fixture instead of adding one.

## Test Evidence
- Red before green on the component tier: the same spec against the unfixed rule fails with `Expected: "13px" Received: "16px"` in the narrow arm.
- Component tier at the PR head: `HeaderFontSizeNarrowWindow` 1/1 and the fixture's sibling `ClickFocus` 4/4 — 5/5 in 4.3 s after `themes.mjs -e dev -n`.
- The other engine rules under the same query (`toolbar/Base.scss`, `component/Markdown.scss`, `app/content/PageContainer.scss`, `button/Base.scss`) are untouched; whether a narrow popup should count as a phone for them is the ticket's Out of Scope.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] The operator's hand: a torn-out Workstation grid (webpack dev server, fresh worker) shows the docked header size.
